rows.claim: OpenCode auto-loads local and global plugins from documented directories at startup.
rows.notes: Docs are explicit. User interactive runtime evidence confirms host startup and profile DB path but does not explicitly show probe file load line.

rows.claim: Plugin exports are plugin functions receiving context and returning hooks; no registerCommand/notify API documented.
rows.notes: Docs define plugin-function export shape. Runtime logs from `opencode run "plugin load check" --print-logs --log-level DEBUG` include probe service logs and successful `validate_plugin_probe` execution.

rows.claim: Documented hooks/events include event router, shell.env, tool.execute.before/after, tui.command.execute, and tui.toast.show.
rows.notes: Runtime confirms `event` hook execution via repeated probe logs (`Event received: ...`). Specific `tui.command.execute`, `tui.toast.show`, and `tool.execute.before/after` hooks still need targeted interactive capture.

rows.claim: No direct plugin command-registration surface equivalent to registerCommand is documented.
rows.notes: Alternative surfaces are tui.command.execute event hook and custom tools.

rows.claim: Messaging can be done with tui.toast.show and client.app.log; direct notify API is not documented.
rows.notes: `client.app.log` messaging surface is runtime-verified by probe log lines (`service=validate-opencode-plugin-api-probe ...`). `tui.toast.show` remains unverified separately but does not block `client.app.log` support.

rows.claim: No restart/relaunch plugin API is documented.
rows.notes: Current adapter canRestart/restart assumptions appear outside documented plugin surface.

rows.claim: shell.env hook can modify environment for tool and shell executions.
rows.notes: Safety respected: no secret/auth file inspection required.

rows.claim: Plugins can be loaded from npm via opencode.json plugin array, installed by Bun, and cached under ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules.
rows.notes: Runtime command `opencode plugin opencode-wakatime --print-logs --log-level DEBUG` confirmed official install flow and `.opencode/opencode.json` update.

rows.claim: Official install uses `opencode plugin <module>` and updates OpenCode config for selected scope.
rows.notes: Validation run confirmed config update semantics for plugin installation.

rows.claim: Plugin tool-first model is documented and supports custom tools via @opencode-ai/plugin tool helper.
rows.notes: Validation probe exported a custom tool and redesign now maps profile operations to plugin tools.
No equivalent API appears in official Plugins docs.
No direct notify API appears in official Plugins docs.

rows.claim: Current adapter assumes optional api.canRestart and api.restart functions.
rows.notes: No restart/relaunch plugin contract is documented.
